metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for engineering work done as planned, proven steps: audits that check what a codebase claims against what it does, plans a cheaper model can build from, and build loops in which nothing is merged on a report alone.

plugins.name: rebuild-factory
plugins.description: Audit, plan and rebuild an existing codebase with a builder you do not have to trust. Five stages, each a skill that writes into one plan folder: a red-team and claims-versus-code audit with numbered findings; the owner's direction; a plan with requirement ids, small sessions, plan-owned fixtures, one phase command and mutation checks; an independent plan review; and a conductor loop that starts a separate coding agent per session through a bundled bridge, reviews its work from a clean clone by breaking things on purpose, merges on a pass and sends findings back on a fail. Ships five agents, a helper script, templates, and the OpenCode bridge as an MCP server. Parameterised per project by a config file; nothing in it is specific to one product.
